name: Content Security Policy (CSP) Header Not Set
reason: Juice Shop sends no CSP by design; the headers sweep keeps the same gap in headers-known.json.

name: Deprecated Feature Policy Header Set
reason: Juice Shop sends Feature-Policy instead of Permissions-Policy; the same issue covers both.

name: Cross-Origin-Embedder-Policy Header Missing or Invalid
reason: One of the isolation headers the shop does not send, filed with its other missing headers.

name: Cross-Domain Misconfiguration
reason: Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * on every response; it does not apply to credentialed requests.

name: Dangerous JS Functions
reason: bypassSecurityTrustHtml in the bundles is how the search term reaches the page as markup.
